name: safe-tidy
description: Inspect a chosen directory, find byte-identical files, and preview a file organization plan. Apply reviewed moves with a receipt and undo unchanged moves later. Never deletes files or overwrites conflicts. Skips repositories, symlinks and unsupported cloud placeholders rather than treating them as clutter.
